name: invalid keys receive no attention
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(10)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(1, 4, 8)
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False]])
encoded, weights = encoder(x, mask)
assert encoded.shape == x.shape and weights.shape == (1, 2, 4, 4)
assert torch.isfinite(encoded).all()
assert torch.equal(weights[..., 2:], torch.zeros_like(weights[..., 2:]))

name: padding values cannot affect valid outputs
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(11)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(1, 4, 8); changed = x.clone(); changed[:, 2:] = 1000
mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False, False]])
a, _ = encoder(x, mask); b, _ = encoder(changed, mask)
assert torch.allclose(a[:, :2], b[:, :2], atol=1e-5)

name: classifier pools only valid states
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(12)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
mean_head = MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, 4, pooling='mean').eval()
max_head = MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, 4, pooling='max').eval()
x = torch.randn(2, 3, 8); mask = torch.tensor([[True, True, False], [True, True, True]])
assert mean_head(x, mask).shape == (2, 4)
assert max_head(x, mask).shape == (2, 4)

name: valid query weights form probability distributions with per-row padding
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(42)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(2, 4, 8)
mask = torch.tensor([[True, False, True, False], [False, True, False, False]])
encoded, weights = encoder(x, mask)
assert torch.isfinite(encoded).all() and torch.isfinite(weights).all()
assert bool((weights >= 0).all())
valid_queries = mask[:, None, :].expand(2, 2, 4)
assert torch.allclose(weights.sum(-1)[valid_queries], torch.ones_like(weights.sum(-1)[valid_queries]), atol=1e-6)
invalid_keys = (~mask)[:, None, None, :].expand_as(weights)
assert torch.equal(weights[invalid_keys], torch.zeros_like(weights[invalid_keys]))

name: both pooling heads ignore padding content and padding length
test:
import torch
torch.manual_seed(43)
encoder = MaskedEncoder(8, 2).eval()
x = torch.randn(2, 2, 8)
mask = torch.ones(2, 2, dtype=torch.bool)
padded = torch.cat([x, torch.full((2, 3, 8), 1000.0)], dim=1)
padded_mask = torch.cat([mask, torch.zeros(2, 3, dtype=torch.bool)], dim=1)
for pooling in ['mean', 'max']:
    head = MaskedEncoderClassifier(encoder, 3, pooling=pooling).eval()
    a = head(x, mask); b = head(padded, padded_mask)
    assert torch.isfinite(a).all() and torch.isfinite(b).all()
    assert torch.allclose(a, b, atol=1e-5), pooling
